entry.title: New: Resolution 286 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO KOHALA LIHIKAI

Approves a grant of $59,298 to Kohala Lihikai, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to provide land stewardship, wildfire mitigation, and cultural education for the Kaiholena property, (Tax Map Keys: 5-8-001:011, 019, 020, 021, 022, and 023), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 286-23 & LAAC-35 - 10/18/23
